description: List files on any integration (cloud or MASV Storage Gateway). Supports pagination — if more results are available, a cursor is returned; pass it back in the next call to get the next page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned from a previous call. Pass this to retrieve the next page of results.

integrationId.description: ID of the cloud or storage gateway integration

path.description: Directory path/prefix to list files from

name: list_files_on_integration
